headline: Bond order of $36,786,032 for roof replacements at Springfield Public Schools, plus dirt bike and food truck ordinances.
summary: Other items include a $1,000,000 grant for the Forest Park Hoticulture and Learning Center and a $500,000 economic development grant. The agenda also lists utility and street petitions, a resolution supporting American International College, and several small donations.
